verdict.rationale: The Speech-to-Text API docs say the timestamps granularity setting 'word' returns word-level timestamps, with an optional 'character' level for finer timing [elevenlabs-scribe-docs-12]. A hands-on community user confirms that word timestamps are returned and used for alignment [elevenlabs-scribe-comm-1]. Their complaint is about punctuation spacing in the text, not about timestamp accuracy, so it does not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: documented response schema showing per-word start/end fields, evidence of word timestamps in the realtime WebSocket mode, and independent verification of timestamp precision.
